activate.title: Activate AI
activate.subtitle: Let your own computer recognise your plants.
activate.how: Recognition runs on your computer through ComfyUI (NVIDIA card), not on our servers. verdure plugs into your existing ComfyUI — lightweight, no Docker.
activate.prereq: Requirement: ComfyUI installed and running on your PC (port 8188).
activate.step1Hint: Open "PowerShell" from the Start menu, paste this line and press Enter. It adds recognition to your ComfyUI.
activate.step2Hint: Restart ComfyUI, then run "start.ps1" (in the verdure-ai folder it created): right-click → Run with PowerShell.
activate.step3Hint: A page opens to check it really is your computer — nothing to copy. Models download on first use (several GB). Your computer then shows up below.
activate.error: That didn't work. Please try again.

pair.title: Connect this computer
pair.prompt: A computer is asking to enable AI on your account:
pair.warning: Only confirm if this code is showing on YOUR computer. This program will be able to process your plant photos.
pair.approved: All set! Your computer is connected. You can head back to the app.
pair.notFound: No valid connection request for this code. The program makes a new one on its own — try again with the new link.
pair.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
